summary.text: Diane Layton is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 34, in the November 3, 2026 general election. She advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Diane Layton was a Republican candidate for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 34 in the November 5, 2024 general election, in which three Democratic incumbents won the district's seats, according to Ballotpedia.
